opening: I get palpitations; my heart races or beats irregularly.
My symptoms get worse when I lie down and better when I sit up.
The pain gets worse when I breathe in deeply.
I'm quite short of breath; it's hard to breathe.
I've had a viral infection recently.

opening.text: I've been having a viral infection recently, and I'm feeling quite short of breath. I have pain that gets worse when I breathe in deeply, and my symptoms get worse when I lie down but better when I sit up. I also get palpitations; my heart races or beats irregularly.
